content:
Here is an idiomatic implementation for the `knr-ops` stack. It follows GitOps best practices: base/overlay separation, ACK CRDs for AWS resources, kustomize patches for environment differentiation, SOPS for secrets, and a dedicated Flux `Kustomization` for isolated reconciliation.

### 📁 Directory Structure
```
knr-ops/
├── flux/
│   └── kustomizations.yaml
├── infra/
│   └── s3/
│       ├── base/
│       │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│       │   ├── bucket.yaml
│       │   └── irsa.yaml
│       └── overlays/
│           ├── dev/
│           │   └── kustomization.yaml
│           └── prod/
│               └── kustomization.yaml
└── secrets/
    └── sops-irsa-config.yaml.enc
```

---

### 1. Base Manifests (`infra/s3/base/`)

**`kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - irsa.yaml
```

**`bucket.yaml`** (ACK S3 Bucket)
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    # Overridden per-env via kustomize patches
    bucket: PLACEHOLDER_BUCKET
    region: PLACEHOLDER_REGION
    versioning:
    - enabled: true
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    - rule:
      applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
      - sseAlgorithm: AES256
    publicAccessBlock:
    - blockPublicAcls: true
      blockPublicPolicy: true
      ignorePublicAcls: true
      restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

**`irsa.yaml`** (ACK IAM + ServiceAccount)
```yaml
apiVersion: role.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRole
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-role
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": { "Federated": "PLACEHOLDER_OIDC_ISSUER" },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": { "PLACEHOLDER_CLUSTER_URL/sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp-logs-sa" }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: policy.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
            "Resource": ["PLACEHOLDER_BUCKET_ARN", "PLACEHOLDER_BUCKET_ARN_OBJ"]
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: rolepolicyattachment.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-attachment
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa-role
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: PLACEHOLDER_ROLE_ARN
```

---

### 2. Environment Overlays

**`infra/s3/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/bucket
        value: myapp
